name: DOB NOW: Safety - Parking Structure Compliance Filings
description:
This dataset contains records from New York City's DOB NOW: Safety system for parking structure compliance filings, covering inspections and reports for parking garages and lots across all five boroughs. Each row represents a filing tied to a specific parking structure, identified by a parking structure ID, BIN, borough, block, lot, address, and ZIP code, along with owner name and building classification. Records include filing status (such as Safe, SREM, Unsafe, or No Report Filed), filing type (initial, amended, or subsequent filings), report status, and inspection cycle details. Many rows also include the number of vehicle parking spaces, counts of EV-capable and EV-ready spaces, structure construction details, and completion dates for unsafe or SREM conditions. Geographic fields such as latitude, longitude, council district, census tract, neighborhood name, and BBL support location-based analysis.

The data could be used to monitor compliance and inspection outcomes for parking structures, identify facilities with EV charging capacity,
